tooltip.jaymospowers.ticking_charm: Worn, it clicks faster the nearer you are to the sick light
jei.jaymospowers.ticking_charm: Worn in the charm slot, it ticks on its own, slowly when the sick light is far and quicker, higher and sharper the nearer you come: by a monolith whose glow has gone green, or by a wolf that has lived too long beside one. It tells you nothing else. Craft it with a clock, two copper ingots, string and an amethyst shard.
